decisions.reason: A niche agricultural crate launched only a year ago is cheap to keep in a mould-based catalogue, and its value in the citrus market is still uncertain, so the option is worth holding.
The foldable large container has a dedicated page and fits core automotive and industrial demand, signalling commitment and promising prospects that do not justify exercising a drop.
A standard stackable crate costs little to carry once tooling exists, and its early, unresolved market reception favors keeping the option open.
The medium-duty rackable pallet complements the pallet range at low marginal cost, and one year is too short for its value to have resolved negatively.
The spill-retention pallet has its own page and serves regulated industrial niches, so its uncertain but plausible value outweighs a small carrying cost.
The pallet with load retainers is featured prominently and addresses beverage and retail handling needs, so there is no evidence yet that the option has failed.
